'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Kyle Krueger DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).<ref name="pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D3.pdf 2010 Worlds Day 3.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org, page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201203002812/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The list is a typed sheet headed "Kyle Krueger Day 3 DS" rather than the standard deck sheet. Deck name on the sheet: '''It's Good To Be Back In The States'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Side:''' Dark
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Knowledge And Defense (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
